justification: Panel A depicts an elaborately costumed anthropomorphic idol figure with layered headdress, mask-like face, and hanging ornaments carved in a dense, curvilinear, highly schematic convention, while Panel B depicts a naturalistic frieze of human attendants and a camel in profile rendered in a smooth, proportionate, low-relief narrative style. There is no overlap in subject matter (no animal in A, no composite anthropomorphic idol in B), no shared relationships between elements, and the stylistic conventions (abstract/ornamental vs. naturalistic/processional) are entirely different.
